notes: The single written *the* of *on the eighth day* goes to the assimilated article on יוֹם (s004) under rule 47's first-article reading, the adjective's agreement article (s006) being the repeated one and so unrepresented; giving it to the adjective's article was the competing reading and is rejected because the ASV's *the* stands at the left edge of the phrase the noun's article opens.

וַיְהִי takes the whole presentative frame *it came to pass ... that* under rules 21 and 45, discontinuous around the temporal phrase; the apodosis קָרָא מֹשֶׁה opens with no waw, so rule 45's waw-carries-the-*that* case does not arise.
All three לְ of the compound object are unrepresented under rule 40, the ASV writing *called Aaron and his sons and the elders* with bare objects.
